Bloomberg reported yesterday that Apple and LG have jointly developed a new smart home accessory to be launched under the LG brand, with leaked images revealing the appearance of a smart door lock, thermostat and temperature sensor.

Images reveal three home accessories reportedly developed by Apple for LG

Next week, Apple is rumoured to be launching a long-awaited major revamp of its home products. The company will bring a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, as well as a brand-new category we've been calling 'HomePad'.

But yesterday's Bloomberg report revealed another piece of Apple's home product puzzle. The company has worked with LG to develop brand-new home accessories, which will be launched under the LG brand.

These accessories reportedly include a smart door lock, thermostat, temperature sensor, video doorbell, indoor camera, outdoor camera and floodlight camera.

Today, leaker pdfu shared the first images of three of these products: a smart door lock, a smart thermostat and a temperature sensor.

LateStage's top-rated comment

LG, you mean the TV brand that was caught monitoring users even when the power was off? Where is Apple's commitment to privacy?

pdfu's post on X also contains more details about these products.

For example, the smart deadbolt comes with a rotating numeric keypad, with settings such as 'touchpad light ring, door ajar audio alert and lock sound volume', and supports features like auto-unlock.

Mark Gurman noted that these new products did not make it in time to launch alongside Apple's new HomePod and Apple TV. However, Apple may still likely mention them at next week's event.

What do you think of these home accessories designed by Apple and launched by LG? Let us know in the comments.

Best Apple Home accessories

  • eufy 4K camera with HomeKit Secure Video support
  • Aqara smart door lock with Apple Home Key and UWB
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug 4-pack
  • Aqara smart thermostat with adaptive temperature support
